scripts.predev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$c=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($c){$p=$c.OwningProcess; Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Freed port 5173 (PID '+$p+')')} else {Write-Host 'Port 5173 already free'}"
